---
title: "Week 13: Suicide, Self-Harm, and the Data Behind Prevention"
---

## Theme

Suicide is the second leading cause of death among people aged 10-34 in
the United States, yet it is among the most undercounted causes of death
in surveillance systems. This week we examine how surveillance systems
capture suicide and self-harm data, what they miss, and how data-driven
approaches can inform prevention policy. Note: This week\'s content
addresses suicide and self-harm. OSU mental health resources: CCS at
ccs.osu.edu or 614-292-5766. Crisis line: dial 988.

## Classroom Lab Demonstration

**Legal Focus:** Safe messaging guidelines (AFSP, SAMHSA) as
professional ethical and legal standards for public health
practitioners; mandatory reporting laws for suicide risk (varies by
state); Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act and its
enforcement gaps; 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline as a legally mandated
service.

**Health Focus:** Age-standardized suicide mortality rates by county,
sex, and race/ethnicity; the rural-urban gradient in suicide rates; the
intersection of opioid use disorder and suicide risk --- revisiting the
opioid treatment desert analysis from Week 11 through a mental health
lens.

**Data:** CDC WISQARS (Web-based Injury Statistics Query and Reporting
System --- wisqars.cdc.gov) for county-level suicide mortality rates by
age, sex, and race; NVDRS narrative excerpts (provided on Carmen,
IRB-approved subset); Ohio ADI and SVI data from previous weeks; MOUD
access isochrones from Week 11.

**R Code:** Manually download WISQARS county-level data as CSV from
wisqars.cdc.gov; join to county shapefile using FIPS; compute
age-standardized rates using direct standardization with standard
population weights; ggplot2 choropleth; compare spatial pattern to
opioid treatment deserts using sf::st_join().

- Access CDC WISQARS (wisqars.cdc.gov); download Ohio county-level
  suicide mortality data by age group, sex, and race/ethnicity as CSV

- Load NVDRS narrative excerpts (Carmen IRB subset); apply tidytext to
  extract the most common circumstances preceding suicide death by
  race/ethnicity

- Map county-level age-standardized suicide rates using ggplot2 + sf;
  overlay ADI and SVI data

- Spatial overlay with Week 11 MOUD treatment desert map: identify
  counties with both high suicide rates and poor MOUD access --- a dual
  crisis geography
